item.title: Pennsylvania Property Tax, Rent Rebate Program now accepting applications
item.description: PENNSYLVANIA (WTAJ) — The Property Tax and Rent Rebate Program (PTRR), designed to help older Pennsylvanians and those with disabilities, is now accepting applications for 2025. Applications are now open for rebates on any property taxes or rent paid in 2025. The maximum standard rebate is $1,000, with the income limit now set at $48,110. [...]
